content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal offer a range of features, including payment processing, invoicing, and analytics. However, these services are often unavailable in certain countries, including Nigeria. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a decentralized and open-source alternative, allowing creators to build and manage their own payment systems. This approach offers greater flexibility and control, enabling creators to adapt to changing market conditions and customer needs.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal often restrict access to their services in certain countries, citing regulatory or compliance issues. This can leave digital creators in these countries without a reliable payment processing solution. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to be accessible and usable regardless of geographical location. By leveraging decentralized technologies and open-source software, creators can build payment systems that are resilient to restrictions and censorship.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional payment processors typically charge a percentage-based fee on each transaction, which can eat into a creator's profit margins. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure often relies on cryptocurrency payments, which can offer faster settlement times and lower fees. Additionally, creators can avoid the costs associated with maintaining a traditional payment processing account, such as monthly subscription fees and chargeback disputes.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure offers greater flexibility and control.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators maintain full ownership and control over their sales process, including payment processing, product delivery, and customer data. This approach also enables automation of key tasks, such as payment verification and product delivery, which can save time and reduce the risk of human error. By leveraging decentralized storage solutions, creators can also ensure that their digital products are delivered quickly and reliably to customers around the world.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For digital creators in Nigeria, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a compelling alternative to traditional payment processors. By leveraging decentralized technologies and open-source software, creators can build resilient and adaptable payment systems that meet their unique needs. When evaluating different architecture options, creators should consider factors such as payment speed, fees, ownership, and automation, as well as the level of control and flexibility they require.
How to sell VST plugins online?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Decentralized payment processing enables faster settlement times and lower fees.

Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
